correctness.rationale: The coordinate-wise Lindbladian acts as n independent qubits. Solving the scalar ODE z_second+(p/n)z_first+4k^2*z/n^2=0 with z(0)=1,z’(0)=0 gives repeated-root critical z=e^{-2kt/n}(1+2kt/n) and overdamped hyperbolic solution. In the near-critical scaling (p_n-4k)(log n)^2/(8k)->theta^2, writing u=2kt/n, alpha_n log n/(8k)->theta yields sqrt(n)z at u_n+c tending e^{-c}sinh(theta)/theta. The log-likelihood ratio for n independent biased bits converges to N(-a^2/2,a^2) under uniform and N(a^2/2,a^2) under bias, giving 2Phi(a/2)-1 total variation; fixed p>4k gives sqrt(n)z->e^{-c}. Strict z-decay and uniform-preserving binary channels justify mixing-time bracket. Independent numerical bisection/ODE checks for n=16384 and 262144, theta=0,0.5,1.5 check finite biases; asymptotic claims rely on the exact proof, not these finite tests.
